name: savvy-flow
description: Orchestrated delivery flow: the session model plans, owns design and reviews; tiered workers implement. Fully specified tasks go to Sonnet, work that needs judgment to Opus on medium effort, Opus on high only on a named trigger; Sonnet workers also fan out in parallel and a Sonnet tester checks the results. Pairs with savvy-progress, and with savvy-limits to route dedicated tracks to Gemini by Claude and Gemini capacity.
